snippet.title: Sprunki Horror from the Loop Trailer
snippet.description:
This is a trailer for my game about Sprunki! I'm going to tell a horror story about my favorite characters and it promises to be quite cruel and interesting. I'm an artist and I work on the game alone, so any kind word, subscription or like will greatly support me! Sprunki to all!
Wishlist Sprunki Horror From The Loop in Steam!
